description: Erection of a joint ground floor rear/side infill extension (30 & 32), and erection of a rear dormer and insertion of rooflights to (30).
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-c8a398e8-7fff-6232-b47f-d8a6f338093e"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span>﻿</span><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposed development would have a detrimental impact upon the character and appearance of the host property whilst failing to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the conservation area. The&nbsp; regularity of the existing outriggers on the terrace and the space provided by the back gardens make a positive contribution to the significance of the CA. The proposal would appear overly prominent, detracting from the simple form of the rear elevation. The proposal would harm the consistent form of the terraces' ground floor rear elevations and would disrupt the consistent pattern of development. No public benefits have been identified that would outweigh the level of harm caused.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposal would therefore </span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;">have an unacceptable impact upon the character and appearance of the host property and its setting within the surrounding conservation area and would not be in accordance with Policies D1, D3, D4 &amp; HC1 of The London Plan (2021), Policy LP1 &amp; LP3 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), REA SPD (2025) and the NPPF.</span></p><div><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;"><br></span></div>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-38dba430-7fff-95f1-02d1-3feaab1c44b7"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"><span style="font-size: 14.6667px;">The proposal would potentially result in have an overbearing and enclosing impact on the neighbouring property No.32’s ground floor rear and side elevation windows and there is not considered to be a suitable mechanism to ensure that both properties carry out the extensions in their entirety as opposed to one of the properties completing only part of the works. The proposal would therefore have an unacceptable impact on neighbouring dwellings amenity.</span></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposed development would have an unacceptable impact on the residential amenity of the neighbouring property No.32 and would be contrary to policy LP2 of LP33 (2020). </span></p><div><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;"><br></span></div>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b76b42fe-7fff-bea5-ff57-17c6ac1725e0"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The proposal is likely to result in harm to mature trees of amenity value located in the rear garden of the application site. No information has been provided regarding the proposals impact on trees located in close proximity to the proposed works. The loss or harm to mature trees could result in impacts to biodiversity, drainage and the character of the conservation area.&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-ef634bc4-7fff-9ad7-b34c-1ecd8509a34f"></span></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;text-align: justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;padding:0pt 5pt 0pt 5pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Due to the lack of information the proposal is deemed to be contrary to Policy LP46 and LP51 of the Local Plan 2033 (2020) </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Policy G5, </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Policy SI 13 of the London Plan (2021), REA SPD 2025 </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;">and the NPPF.</span></p>
